G1.what: measured tokens per call fit the quota (or the cut order applies); reasoning setting frozen

G2.what: V1 criteria met on the validity battery

G4.what: QNFA beats variable-string cosine on VACS and reaches the dev F1 floor

G-YIELD.what: S1 yield counted; narrowing rule applied if S1 test is under 60

G-FREEZE.what: no test answer exists before the prereg-v1 tag

G7.what: V2: reader precision >= 0.95, recall >= 0.85, counterfactual and null criteria
